records.source_statement: If translating planet gives hostile aspect to an infortune without reception, the marriage may fail; absence of this allows completion, especially with benefic.
limitations: Negative aspect and lack of reception matter.

records.source_statement: New subsection asks whether a conceived child is offspring of the reputed father.
limitations: This is historical paternity speculation, not a genetic test.

records.source_statement: For that claim, ascendant lord/Moon represent interrogant, while eleventh house/lord are said to signify the issue in conception.
limitations: Do not silently replace eleventh with usual radical fifth; source says eleventh.

records.source_statement: Favourable trine or sextile between relevant signifiers, with or without reception, is called supporting paternity.
limitations: Source's eleventh ruler and identified parties required.

records.source_statement: Square or opposition with mutual reception and perfect aspect may be treated positively.
limitations: Contrasts to hard aspect without reception.

records.source_statement: First lord/Moon in fifth or fifth lord in first, without malefic obstruction, supplies another claimed paternity testimony.
Fortunes regarding fifth house/lord are further claimed as supporting parentage.
limitations: Source lists this as alternative corroboration.
